title: aegilops cylindrica f. brunnea
intro: Aegilops cylindrica f. brunnea, commonly known as a variant of the wild goatgrass, is a type of plant in the grass family (Poaceae). It has been found to possess various health benefits, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help protect against oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Aegilops cylindrica f. brunnea include its potential to act as an immune system modulator and its possible antimicrobial and antifungal effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that may contribute to its medicinal properties.
